name: Grand Destiny — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Grand Destiny from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Grand Destiny" but are not part of the Grand Destiny entry, which is unchanged.

Grand Destiny

School enchantment (compulsion) [mindaffecting]; Level alchemist/investigator 5, arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 5, bard/skald 4, medium 4, mesmerist 5, summoner 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect one willing creature
Duration 10 minutes/level or until discharged
Saving Throw none (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You inspire the target to seize a grand destiny.
